name: gemini-mcp
description: Gemini (spot) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endp

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every trading symbol in Gemini's lower-case form (btcusd, ethbtc); base/quote are not in this list (see the symbol details page). Paged locally; `query` is a substring of the symbol.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: volume is the 24h volume in the base currency (the first key of the volume object, e.g. BTC for btcusd).

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval is Gemini's time frame: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1hr, 6hr, 1day. Candles come newest first; the newest `limit` are returned.
